lines.en: Quiet. The throne is sleeping.
If the shell cracks, I find another.
My old shell is still buried over there.

lines.zh: 我沿着潮线巡自己的滩。
lines.en: I patrol my beach along the tide line.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩，我走了几百年。
lines.en: I have walked this beach for centuries.
My shadow arrives before me.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的壳都是我的兵。
lines.en: Every shell on this beach is my soldier.

lines.zh: 每走一步，沙子都往下陷。
lines.en: Each step sinks deeper into the sand.
This shell drums when I knock it.

lines.zh: 我的壳压过沙，留下深沟。
lines.en: My shell ploughs a deep furrow in the sand.
Someone's watching me from the beach.
The silence of this beach is mine.
The horn on my head is worn smooth and bright.

lines.zh: 云飘过去，我数到第七朵。
lines.en: A cloud passes; I counted to seven.
The tide has washed away your footprints.

lines.zh: 沙滩的潮水，一年年给我换壳。
lines.en: The tide gives me a new shell each year.
The tide went out and has not come back.
Fine sand is stuck in the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 一层沙，盖住了我的棱角。
lines.en: A layer of sand dulls my edges.
I bury my trophies beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 我这只壳，比沙滩上的石头还老。
lines.en: My shell is older than the stones on this beach.
The sea wind has chilled my shell.
I count the waves until I lose the count.

lines.zh: 缩在壳里，想着值不值得动。
lines.en: Tucked in my shell, wondering if it's worth moving.
Do not break this quiet.
This sea has never changed.

lines.zh: 你站在潮线上，脚在往后退。
lines.en: You stand at the tideline, your feet edging back.
Your breathing has lost its rhythm.

lines.zh: 这片滩涂，我还没让给谁。
lines.en: I have not yielded this shore to anyone.
At last, someone breaks the silence.
Your sword hand is sweating.
Come closer. I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 沙滩的热气，烤得壳发烫。
lines.en: Beach heat bakes my shell.
Look up. My crown is bright.

lines.zh: 我的触角在探你的方向。
lines.en: My antennae test which way you are.

lines.zh: 你的影子，落在我的壳上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my shell.

lines.zh: 你在我面前，只到我胸口。
lines.en: Standing before me, you reach only my chest.

lines.zh: 你的味道，像上次那个人。
lines.en: You smell like the last one who came.

lines.zh: 刀口只刮下我壳上的粉。
lines.en: Your blade only scraped dust off my shell.
That one is recorded.

lines.zh: 我这壳很厚，你的刀会钝。
lines.en: My shell is thick; your blade will dull.

lines.zh: 王也会疼，只是壳挡住了。
lines.en: Kings hurt too — the shell just hides it.
My shell turns, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我壳门一关，你的刀落空了。
lines.en: I close my shell, and your blade strikes nothing.
This shell has stayed with me for centuries.
An old shell cracked, and I mended it.
I do not cry out; a king does not cry out.
Pain is back — I had missed it.
My fingers itch for it.
Offer it, then step back three paces.

lines.zh: 那味道，是从你手上来的。
lines.en: That smell comes from your hand.
This smell is from long ago.
A flower fell on the sand; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我也想要你手里那样东西。
lines.en: I too want that thing in your hand.
I open my shell and there you are.
What you hold is not enough.

lines.zh: 沙滩的潮水，把壳推来推去。
lines.en: The tide rolls my shell back and forth.

lines.zh: 举到壳口那么高，我才够得着。
lines.en: Raise it to my shell opening, and I can reach it.
My shell's rim is sharp; do not come too near.
The king's road is wide and costly.
The rim of my shell cuts into the sand.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，壳就把你挤开。
lines.en: I turn sideways and my shell shoves you away.

lines.zh: 沙滩上，我这壳有半人高。
lines.en: On the beach my shell stands half a man tall.
You ran into my ridged edge.
Mind yourself, little one.
You stepped on my shadow.

lines.zh: 这一步，我本可以踩下去。
lines.en: I could have put my full weight into that step.

lines.zh: 我这只壳，比你的船还沉。
lines.en: This shell weighs more than your boat.
We shall bear the crown together.
Two shells together keep out the cold.

lines.zh: 我这壳换过三次，誓约没换过。
lines.en: I have changed shells three times, not this oath.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的古老仪式，只差你。
lines.en: The old rite on the beach awaits only you.
This beach holds room for only two kings.
By my petals, heaven witnesses.
This shell of mine has been empty a long time.
Our shells rest side by side.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的老王，壳上有纹。
lines.en: The old king of the beach bears a patterned shell.

lines.zh: 潮声盖过了我们的低语。
lines.en: The surf covers our low voices.

lines.zh: 弯一次腰，不算失了我这身份。
lines.en: One bow costs me no dignity.
There is always something beneath the sand.
This is no longer yours.
The tide goes out and comes back.
I press it under my shell.
I bend, and my shell nearly jams.

lines.zh: 壳上的灰，擦干净才像王。
lines.en: Dust off the shell, only then do I look like a king.
This one joins my collection.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的，一件件摆好。
lines.en: I set out everything I have gathered.

lines.zh: 这块贝壳，是我新收的藏品。
lines.en: This shell is my newest collection piece.
I lower my shell, ready to charge.
You stand on the slope; perfect.
This shore I grant to you.

lines.zh: 海风把你的味道送过来。
lines.en: The sea wind carries your scent to me.
My eye sockets are fixed on you.

lines.zh: 沙滩底下，我听见你踩沙。
lines.en: Under the sand, I hear you step.
On the beach, I carry my shell.
Run; the beach offers no cover.
The opening of my shell faces you now.
You are standing on my old battleground.
Today, it is you.

lines.zh: 王座下面的沙，就是你的位置。
lines.en: The sand under my throne is where you belong.
Living in this shell, I forgot my name.

lines.zh: 唱片我留着，战利品也留着。
lines.en: I keep the record, and the loot too.
My shell moved in the sand before you noticed.
On this stretch, only you and I remain.
Sand grains crunch under my shell.
What I choose, I never let go.
A hundred seventy health, still growing.
The tide withdraws; you push on.

lines.zh: 沙滩转个弯，也还是死路。
lines.en: The beach bends, and it's still a dead end.
Circle me three times, then we talk.

lines.zh: 你的影子先跑到我脚边。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches my feet before you do.
Living blood runs fastest.

lines.zh: 潮声盖着我的脚步，你听不见。
lines.en: The surf covers my footsteps; you hear nothing.
My shell drags a furrow behind me.

lines.zh: 半个沙滩的蟹都听我号令。
lines.en: Half the beach's crabs answer me.
This woods has no exit.
My steps are slow, but never off course.
Every step I take leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 半血之后，我缩进壳里歇着。
lines.en: At half health, I retreat into my shell.

lines.zh: 别停，我壳里的力气还多。
lines.en: Don't stop. My shell still has strength.
Turning your back on me is disrespect.

lines.zh: 我的王座是一只大螺壳。
lines.en: My throne is one great spiral shell.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也在这片滩上。
lines.en: However fast you run, you are still on this beach.
This old shell should move again.

lines.zh: 走累了，就缩进壳里歇会儿。
lines.en: Tired of walking, I rest inside my shell.
I can hear you panting now.
I used only half a shell's worth of force.

lines.zh: 我的壳砸下去，沙都跳起来。
lines.en: My shell crashes down and the sand leaps.
My claw clamps onto your shoulder.
That was only the opening.

lines.zh: 贝壳里待久了，出手会慢。
lines.en: Too long in the shell makes one slow.
My whole shell bears down.
You are still standing because I held back.
My claw draws back.
My claw is louder than the surf.
You kept your footing; that counts for something.
Do not flinch. Let me see you.

lines.zh: 我这只钳子，先敲了敲地。
lines.en: My claw tapped the sand first.
Old custom: courtesy first, then the blade.
A hundred and seventy points of weight come down.
I push half my shell up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，壳还沉。
lines.en: I climb out of the sand, my shell still heavy.

lines.zh: 潮水退下去，我的壳才露头。
lines.en: The tide falls, and only then does my shell show.
The tide pushes me ashore.
One hundred seventy points, and a heavy shell.
My shell breaks the surface first.

lines.zh: 我在沙里醒来，壳还带着潮气。
lines.en: I wake in sand, shell still damp.

lines.zh: 沙下传出壳磨沙的声音。
lines.en: Under the sand comes the grind of shell on shell.

lines.zh: 一百七十点血，缩壳也算数。
lines.en: A hundred and seventy, and hiding still counts.

lines.zh: 我从壳里出来，带来了战争。
lines.en: I came out of my shell and brought war.
Stand clear — the king is turning.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的潮声，是我唯一的侍从。
lines.en: The surf on the beach is my only court.

lines.zh: 壳里的灯亮了，王也醒了。
lines.en: The lamp in my shell lit, and the king woke.

lines.zh: 沙埋了我多久，没人知道。
lines.en: Nobody knows how long the sand buried me.

lines.zh: 沙子从我壳口一粒粒滑下来。
lines.en: Sand slips grain by grain from my shell opening.
This shore has changed shape several times.
This woods, awaken.
The sand rises, so all of you scatter.
Speak my name: Hermit King.
I plant myself on this tide line first.
My shell glows red like a furnace.
Landing is also a royal art.
Even water wants to keep me?
A fine blast.
An arrow is a coward's gift.

lines.zh: 魔法？我的名字本身是咒。
lines.en: Magic? My name is a curse.
How long have supplies been cut?
Even the sky challenges me?
Falling is the true loneliness.
